data.name: Muhaddas
data.gender_notes: Muhaddas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who memorizes and preserves knowledge, particularly religious texts such as the Quran. The name Muhaddas carries the meaning “Memorizer, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhaddas usually hope their child will grow to embody memorizer, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To honor the sacred duty of preserving knowledge and wisdom for future generations.
data.etymology: Muhaddas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Memorizer, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaddas total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: محدث
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى الحديث النبوي، متحدث، مذيع
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحدث هو الشخص الذي يروي الحديث النبوي ويحفظه ويعرفه جيدًا، وهو من المصطلحات الإسلامية المهمة في علم الحديث، حيث يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بمعرفته بالحديث النبوي وعلومه، ويُستخدم هذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يتبوأ مكانة عالية في علم الحديث وروايته.

in_urdu.name: محدث
in_urdu.meaning: حديث نبوی سے متعلق، ایک شخص جو حدیث کو حفظ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: محدث وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو حدیث نبوی کو روایت کرتا ہے، حفظ کرتا ہے، اور اس کا علم رکھتا ہے۔ یہ اسلامی اصطلاح علم حدیث میں اہم ہے، جو اس شخص کی نشاندہی کرتی ہے جو حدیث نبوی اور اس کی علوم میں مہارت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو حدیث کی روایت اور علم میں اعلیٰ مقام رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहद्दस
in_hindi.meaning: नबी की बातों से जुड़ा, एक व्यक्ति जो हदीस को याद करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहद्दस वह व्यक्ति होता है जो नबी की बातों (हदीस) को याद करता है, उन्हें संजोता है, और उनका ज्ञान रखता है। यह इस्लामी शब्द हदीस के विज्ञान में महत्वपूर्ण है, जो उस व्यक्ति की ओर संकेत करता है जो हदीस और उसके विज्ञान में प्रवीण होता है। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो हदीस की संग्रहण और ज्ञान में उच्च स्थान रखता है।

in_pashto.name: محدث
in_pashto.meaning: د نبي د خبرو سره تړلی، هغه څوک چې حديث پېژني
in_pashto.long_meaning: محدث هغه څوک دی چې د نبي د خبرو (حديث) په اړه پوهېږي، يې حفظوي، او د هغې علم لري. دا اسلامي اصطلاح د حديث په علم کې مهمه ده، کوم چې د هغه چا په ګوته کوي چې د حديث او د هغې په علومو کې مهارت لري. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کېږي چې د حديث د روايت او علم په اړه لوړ مقام لري.

in_english.name: Muhaddas
in_english.meaning: Related to the Hadith, narrator of Hadith
in_english.long_meaning: Muhaddas refers to a person who is knowledgeable in the Hadith (sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad) and is involved in its narration, preservation, and dissemination. The term is significant in Islamic scholarship, particularly in the field of Hadith studies. It denotes someone who has a deep understanding and expertise in Hadith literature and its various sciences. The name Muhaddas is given to individuals who hold a distinguished position in the field of Hadith studies and its traditions.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: محدث

data.cultural_impact: The title "Muhaddas" holds a significant cultural impact within the Islamic community as it denotes a person who possesses profound knowledge and is dedicated to preserving and transmitting it. In traditional societies, these individuals were held in high esteem, as they served as repositories of sacred texts and wisdom. They were often sought after for guidance, and their knowledge and dedication inspired awe and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the significance of the title "Muhaddas" lies in its connection to the preservation and transmission of sacred knowledge. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that preserving God's word, as contained in the Quran, is an act of worship and a means of drawing closer to God. The Muhaddis, therefore, serves a vital role in maintaining the spiritual integrity of the community by ensuring that the sacred texts are preserved, transmitted accurately, and taught to future generations. Additionally, the intensive study required to become a Muhaddis can be seen as a form of spiritual discipline and devotion, as one delves deeply into the religious texts.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Memorizer, Scholar" symbolizes One who memorizes and preserves knowledge, particularly religious texts such as the Quran.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhaddas serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of memorizer, scholar.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidāyah wa l-Nihāyah, Vol. 8, P. 345-346. The name Muhaddas carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muhaddas ibn Mansur Al-Khuzani was a scholar from Khuzistan (in present-day Iran). He was renowned for his knowledge of hadith and fiqh. His name Muhaddas means 'The Annotated' due to the annotated books he authored.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hadī, Al-Muqaddasah fī ad-Dīn, Vol. 4, P. 277-278. The name Muhaddas carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muhaddas ibn Mansur Al-Yamani was a famous scholar of the 8th Islamic century. He was a secretary to the Abbasid Caliph Harun Al-Rashid. His work, Al-Muqaddasah fī ad-Dīn, was a renowned work in the field of Islamic jurisprudence. The name Muhaddas means 'The Annotated' due to the annotated notes he added to his works.
